description.en:
While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are
stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.
description.fr: Au début de sa vie, il se nourrit des nutriments accumulés dans la graine sur son dos. Cela lui permet de grandir.
description.es: Desde que nace, crece alimentándose de los nutrientes que contiene la semilla de su lomo.
description.it: Dopo la nascita, per un periodo di tempo cresce assorbendo i nutrienti stipati nel bulbo sul dorso.
description.de: Nach der Geburt nutzt es für eine Weile die Nährstoffe im Samen auf seinem Rücken, um zu wachsen.
description.pt-br: Durante sua juventude, usa os nutrientes armazenados na semente em suas costas para crescer.
description.zh-tw: 在出生後的一段時間內，牠會吸收背上種子裡儲存著的營養成長。
description.ja:
While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are
stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.
description.ko:
While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are
stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

description.en:
The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more
strength wells up within it, allowing the bud
on its back to grow larger.
description.fr: Plus il s'expose au soleil, plus il emmagasine d'énergie, ce qui permet au bourgeon sur son dos de se développer.
description.es: La luz del sol lo fortalece y hace que le crezca el capullo que tiene en el lomo.
description.it: Più si espone alla luce solare, più acquisisce energia facendo crescere il bocciolo che ha sul dorso.
description.de: Die Sonne macht es stärker. Die Knospe auf seinem Rücken wächst unter dem Einfluss von Sonnenlicht.
description.pt-br: Quanto mais banho de sol Ivysaur toma, mais força brota em seu interior, fazendo com que o botão nas suas costas cresça.
description.zh-tw: 沐浴在陽光下越久，身體內會湧出越多力量，背上的花苞也會漸漸成長。
description.ja:
The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more
strength wells up within it, allowing the bud
on its back to grow larger.
description.ko:
The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more
strength wells up within it, allowing the bud
on its back to grow larger.

effect.en: Take 2 {G} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
effect.fr: Prenez 2 Énergies {G} de votre zone Énergie et attachez-les à ce Pokémon.
effect.es: Une 2 Energías {G} de tu área de Energía a este Pokémon.
effect.it: Prendi 2 Energie {G} dalla tua Zona Energia e assegnale a questo Pokémon.
effect.de: Lege 2 {G}-Energien aus deinem Energiebereich an dieses Pokémon an.
effect.pt-br: Pegue 2 Energias {G} da sua Zona de Energia e ligue-as a este Pokémon.
effect.zh-tw: 從自己的能量區抽出2個{G}能量,附於這隻寶可夢身上。
effect.ja: Take 2 {G} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
effect.ko: Take 2 {G} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

effect.en: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Asleep.
effect.fr: Le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire est maintenant Empoisonné et Endormi.
effect.es: El Pokémon Activo de tu rival pasa a estar Envenenado y Dormido.
effect.it: Il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario viene avvelenato e addormentato.
effect.de: Das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners ist jetzt vergiftet und schläft.
effect.pt-br: O Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente agora está Envenenado e Adormecido.
effect.zh-tw: 將對手的戰鬥寶可夢中毒與睡眠。
effect.ja: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Asleep.
effect.ko: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Asleep.

description.en: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
description.fr: Ses petites pattes munies de ventouses lui permettent de monter les pentes et de grimper aux murs sans se fatiguer.
description.es: Sus cortas patas están recubiertas de ventosas que le permiten subir incansable por muros y cuestas.
description.it: Le ventose sulle sue corte zampe gli permettono di affrontare ogni salita e di scalare senza fatica qualsiasi muro.
description.de: Es hat Saugnäpfe an den Beinchen, mit denen es mühelos Steigungen und Mauern erklimmen kann.
description.pt-br: Seus pés curtos contam com ventosas que permitem que escale penhascos e paredes sem se cansar.
description.zh-tw: 別看牠的腳很短，因為是吸盤，所以無論是斜坡還是牆壁都能輕鬆前進。
description.ja: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
description.ko: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

effect.en: At the end of your opponent's turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put a random card from your deck that evolves from this Pokémon onto this Pokémon to evolve it.
effect.fr: À la fin du tour de votre adversaire, si ce Pokémon est sur le Poste Actif, prenez au hasard une carte qui évolue à partir de ce Pokémon dans votre deck, puis placez‐la sur ce Pokémon pour le faire évoluer.
effect.es: Al final del turno de tu rival, si este Pokémon está en el Puesto Activo, pon una carta aleatoria de tu baraja que evolucione de este Pokémon sobre este Pokémon para hacerlo evolucionar.
effect.it: Alla fine del turno del tuo avversario, se questo Pokémon è in posizione attiva, prendi dal mazzo una carta a caso che si evolve da questo Pokémon e mettigliela sopra per farlo evolvere.
effect.de: Lege am Ende des Zuges deines Gegners, wenn dieses Pokémon in der Aktiven Position ist, eine zufällige Karte aus deinem Deck, die sich aus diesem Pokémon entwickelt, auf dieses Pokémon, um es zu entwickeln.
effect.pt-br: No final do turno do seu oponente, se este Pokémon estiver no Campo Ativo, coloque uma carta aleatória do seu baralho que evolua deste Pokémon sobre este Pokémon para evoluí-lo.
effect.zh-tw: 在對手的回合結束時,若這隻寶可夢在戰鬥場上,則從自己的牌庫隨機將1張從這隻寶可夢進化而來的卡,放置於這隻寶可夢身上完成進化。
effect.ja: At the end of your opponent's turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put a random card from your deck that evolves from this Pokémon onto this Pokémon to evolve it.
effect.ko: At the end of your opponent's turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put a random card from your deck that evolves from this Pokémon onto this Pokémon to evolve it.

description.en: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.
description.fr: Bien que son corps soit entouré d'une carapace solide, l'intérieur est si mou qu'il ne résisterait pas à une attaque violente.
description.es: Aunque cuenta con una coraza muy dura, tiene un cuerpo bastante blando. Un ataque violento puede acabar con él.
description.it: La corazza esterna è robusta ma l'interno è molle. Per questo non è in grado di resistere ad attacchi particolarmente veementi.
description.de: In seiner harten Schale ist ein weicher Körper. Einem brutalen Angriff hat es nichts entgegenzusetzen.
description.pt-br: Apesar de estar envolto em um casco espesso, o interior do seu corpo é frágil, e por isso não aguenta ataques muito fortes.
description.zh-tw: 雖然有堅硬的外殼，但因為殼裡的身體很軟，所以無法抵抗強力的攻擊。
description.ja: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.
description.ko: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.

description.en: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
description.fr: Il ramasse du nectar chaque jour et l'agglutine sur les poils de ses pattes pour le transporter jusqu'à son nid.
description.es: Recoge néctar a diario y se lo adhiere al pelo de las patas para llevarlo a su nido.
description.it: Raccoglie nettare tutti i giorni e lo spalma sulla peluria che ricopre le sue zampe per trasportarlo al nido.
description.de: Es sammelt täglich Honig. Es reibt ihn in seine Beinhaare, um ihn in sein Nest zu transportieren.
description.pt-br: Coleta mel todos os dias. Para transportá-lo até o seu ninho, esfrega mel no pelo de suas pernas.
description.zh-tw: 每天都忙著採集花蜜。習慣在腿部的細毛上塗滿花蜜，然後帶回巢穴裡。
description.ja: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
description.ko: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

effect.en: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.
effect.fr: Soignez 20 dégâts de ce Pokémon.
effect.es: Cura 20 puntos de daño a este Pokémon.
effect.it: Cura questo Pokémon da 20 danni.
effect.de: Heile 20 Schadenspunkte bei diesem Pokémon.
effect.pt-br: Cure 20 pontos de dano deste Pokémon.
effect.zh-tw: 將這隻寶可夢恢復20HP。
effect.ja: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.
effect.ko: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

description.en: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
description.fr: À force de trancher des objets solides, ses avant-bras en forme de faux deviennent de plus en plus acérés.
description.es: Las cortantes guadañas de sus antebrazos se vuelven más afiladas cada vez que cortan objetos duros.
description.it: Le falci sulle sue zampe anteriori diventano sempre più affilate man mano che tranciano oggetti duri.
description.de: Die scharfen Sicheln an den Unterarmen werden durch das Schneiden harter Objekte noch schärfer.
description.pt-br: As foices afiadas em seus antebraços se tornam cada vez mais afiadas ao cortarem objetos duros.
description.zh-tw: 雙手的鐮刀鋒利無比，砍斷越多堅硬的東西，其鋒利程度也會隨之提升。
description.ja: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
description.ko: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

effect.en: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
effect.fr: Échangez ce Pokémon contre l'un de vos Pokémon de Banc.
effect.es: Cambia este Pokémon por 1 de tus Pokémon en Banca.
effect.it: Scambia questo Pokémon con uno della tua panchina.
effect.de: Tausche dieses Pokémon gegen 1 Pokémon auf deiner Bank aus.
effect.pt-br: Troque este Pokémon por 1 dos seus Pokémon no Banco.
effect.zh-tw: 將這隻寶可夢與備戰寶可夢互換。
effect.ja: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
effect.ko: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

effect.en: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 70 more damage.
effect.fr: Lancez une pièce. Si c'est face, cette attaque inflige 70 dégâts de plus.
effect.es: Lanza 1 moneda. Si sale cara, este ataque hace 70 puntos de daño más.
effect.it: Lancia una moneta. Se esce testa, questo attacco infligge 70 danni in più.
effect.de: Wirf 1 Münze. Bei Kopf fügt diese Attacke 70 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.
effect.pt-br: Jogue uma moeda. Se sair cara, este ataque causará 70 pontos de dano a mais.
effect.zh-tw: 擲1次硬幣若為正面,則增加70點傷害。
effect.ja: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 70 more damage.
effect.ko: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 70 more damage.

description.en: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.
description.fr: Ce Pokémon venu du futur soigne les blessures et donne de la force aux plantes.
description.es: Vino del futuro haciendo un viaje en el tiempo. Además de curar las heridas, posee la capacidad de revitalizar la hierba y los árboles.
description.it: È giunto dal futuro, viaggiando nel tempo. Cura le ferite e dona vigore alla vegetazione.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon kommt aus der Zukunft und ist durch die Zeit gereist. Es heilt Wunden und spendet Pflanzen Kraft.
description.pt-br: Este Pokémon viajou no tempo e veio do futuro. Ele revigora a grama e as árvores com sua própria força e pode curar feridas.
description.zh-tw: 從未來穿越時光而來。能夠治癒傷痛，也會把自己的力量分給草木。
description.ja: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.
description.ko: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

effect.en: Each of your evolved Pokémon can use any attack from its previous Evolutions. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)
effect.fr: Chacun de vos Pokémon évolués peut utiliser les attaques de ses précédentes Évolutions. (Vous avez toujours besoin de l'Énergie nécessaire pour utiliser chaque attaque.)
effect.es: Cada uno de tus Pokémon evolucionados puede usar cualquier ataque de sus Evoluciones anteriores. (Sigues necesitando la Energía necesaria para usar cada ataque).
effect.it: Ciascuno dei tuoi Pokémon evoluti può usare gli attacchi dei suoi stadi evolutivi precedenti. Devi comunque avere l'Energia necessaria per usare quegli attacchi.
effect.de: Jedes deiner entwickelten Pokémon kann die Attacken seiner vorangegangenen Entwicklungen einsetzen. (Du benötigst jedoch die jeweils für die Attacke notwendige Energie.)
effect.pt-br: Cada um dos seus Pokémon evoluídos pode usar qualquer ataque de suas Evoluções anteriores. (Você ainda precisa da Energia necessária para usar cada ataque.)
effect.zh-tw: 只要這隻寶可夢在場上,自己的所有進化寶可夢,可使用進化前持有的所有招式。[[需要有足夠使用招式的能量。]]
effect.ja: Each of your evolved Pokémon can use any attack from its previous Evolutions. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)
effect.ko: Each of your evolved Pokémon can use any attack from its previous Evolutions. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

description.en: Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.
description.fr: Il grimpe sur les murs avec une grande agilité. Sa queue lui permet de mesurer l'humidité et de prédire ainsi le temps qu'il fera le lendemain.
description.es: Escala con rapidez incluso superficies verticales. Percibe la humedad ambiental con la cola y así prevé el tiempo que hará al día siguiente.
description.it: Riesce a scalare rapidamente anche pareti verticali. Rileva l'umidità attraverso la coda per prevedere il tempo dell'indomani.
description.de: Es kann selbst Wände blitzschnell emporklettern. Mit seinem Schwanz misst es die Luftfeuchtigkeit, um das Wetter des nächsten Tages vorherzusagen.
description.pt-br: Treecko consegue escalar superfícies verticais com facilidade. Usa a cauda para sentir a umidade do ar e prever o clima do dia seguinte.
description.zh-tw: 在垂直的牆壁上也能輕快地攀爬。會用尾巴感知空氣的濕度，以此來判斷明天的天氣。
description.ja: Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.
description.ko: Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.

description.en: Grovyle leaps from branch to branch in large trees, moving with ease. It propels itself with astounding speed and force.
description.fr: Il se déplace dans les grands arbres en sautant avec agilité de branche en branche. Sa vivacité est extraordinaire.
description.es: Se desplaza saltando grácilmente de rama en rama por los árboles más altos, haciendo gala de su tremenda agilidad.
description.it: Si sposta saltando agilmente tra i rami di grandi alberi. È capace di scatti impressionanti.
description.de: Es verfügt über eine erstaunliche Sprungkraft und bewegt sich auf hohen Bäumen mit Leichtigkeit von Ast zu Ast fort.
description.pt-br: Grovyle salta de galho em galho em grandes árvores com total facilidade, impulsionando-se com velocidade e força impressionantes.
description.zh-tw: 會在大樹的枝頭間輕巧地跳躍移動。爆發力十分驚人。
description.ja: Grovyle leaps from branch to branch in large trees, moving with ease. It propels itself with astounding speed and force.
description.ko: Grovyle leaps from branch to branch in large trees, moving with ease. It propels itself with astounding speed and force.

effect.pt-br: Este ataque causa 50 pontos de dano a 1 dos Pokémon no Banco do seu oponente.
effect.zh-tw: 對手的1隻備戰寶可夢受到50點傷害。
effect.ja: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
effect.ko: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

effect.ko: Discard {G} Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

description.en: This Pokémon is highly sensitive to temperature changes. When its bud starts to open, that means spring is right around the corner.
description.fr: Il est sensible aux variations de température. Quand son bourgeon commence à s'ouvrir, l'arrivée du printemps est imminente.
description.es: Es muy sensible a los cambios de temperatura. Anuncia la llegada inminente de la primavera cuando florece.
description.it: È sensibile agli sbalzi di temperatura. Quando le sue gemme si schiudono è segno che la primavera è vicina.
description.de: Es hat ein feines Gespür für die kleinsten Temperaturveränderungen. Wenn sich seine Knospe öffnet, bricht bald der Frühling an.
description.pt-br: Este Pokémon é extremamente sensível a mudanças de temperatura. Quando seu botão começa a se abrir, é sinal de que a primavera está chegando.
description.zh-tw: 對氣溫的變化很敏感。當牠開始打開花苞，便是冬去春來之時。
description.ja: This Pokémon is highly sensitive to temperature changes. When its bud starts to open, that means spring is right around the corner.
description.ko: This Pokémon is highly sensitive to temperature changes. When its bud starts to open, that means spring is right around the corner.

effect.en: The Defending Pokémon loses all Abilities. This effect lasts until the Defending Pokémon leaves the Active Spot.
effect.fr: Le Pokémon Défenseur perd tout talent. Cet effet s'applique jusqu'à ce que le Pokémon Défenseur quitte le Poste Actif.
effect.es: El Pokémon Defensor pierde todas las habilidades. El efecto perdura hasta que el Pokémon Defensor deje el Puesto Activo.
effect.it: Il Pokémon difensore perde tutte le abilità. Questo effetto dura finché il Pokémon difensore non abbandona la posizione attiva.
effect.de: Das Verteidigende Pokémon verliert alle Fähigkeiten. Dieser Effekt hält an, bis das Verteidigende Pokémon die Aktive Position verlässt.
effect.pt-br: O Pokémon Defensor perde todas as Habilidades. Este efeito dura até o Pokémon Defensor sair do Campo Ativo.
effect.zh-tw: 將受到這個招式的寶可夢的特性全部消除。這個效果在受到這個招式的寶可夢離開戰鬥場前一直持續。
effect.ja: The Defending Pokémon loses all Abilities. This effect lasts until the Defending Pokémon leaves the Active Spot.
effect.ko: The Defending Pokémon loses all Abilities. This effect lasts until the Defending Pokémon leaves the Active Spot.

description.en: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.
description.fr: Ce trio inséparable depuis la naissance passe son temps à récolter le nectar des fleurs pour satisfaire Apireine.
description.es: El trío se forma al nacer y se pasa la vida recogiendo néctar de las flores para satisfacer a Vespiquen.
description.it: Il trio è insieme dalla nascita. Passa il tempo a raccogliere il nettare dei fiori per far felice Vespiquen.
description.de: Dieses Trio ist von Geburt an zusammen. Es sammelt fleißig Blütennektar, um Honweisel eine Freude zu bereiten.
description.pt-br: O trio está unido desde o nascimento. Coleta néctar de flores constantemente para agradar Vespiquen.
description.zh-tw: 從出生那時起就是3隻一起。為了取悅蜂女王，一直都在採集著花蜜。
description.ja: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.
description.ko: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.

effect.de: Du kannst 1 Basis-{G}-Pokémon von deiner Bank auf deinen Ablagestapel legen. Wenn du das machst, fügt diese Attacke 70 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.
effect.ja: You may discard 1 of your Benched Basic {G} Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 70 more damage.
effect.ko: You may discard 1 of your Benched Basic {G} Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 70 more damage.

description.en:
It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself.
If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds,
it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.
description.fr: Il sème du coton pour se protéger. Il lui arrive d'être emporté par une tempête à l'autre bout du monde.
description.es: Lanza bolas de algodón para defenderse. A veces, la fuerza de un tifón llega a arrastrarlo hasta el otro extremo del mundo.
description.it: Si difende creando una nuvola di cotone. A volte viene trasportato fino all'altro capo del mondo dai tifoni.
description.de: Sie schützen sich, indem sie Watte verstreuen. Manche werden vom Wind bis ans andere Ende der Welt getragen.
description.pt-br: Dispara algodão do seu corpo para se proteger. Se este Pokémon for carregado por um furacão, pode ir parar do outro lado da Terra.
description.zh-tw: 會噴出棉花保護身體。有時會被颱風吹到地球的另一邊。
description.ja:
It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself.
If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds,
it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.
description.ko:
It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself.
If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds,
it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

effect.en: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.
effect.fr: Cette attaque inflige 30 dégâts supplémentaires pour chaque Énergie dans le Coût de Retraite du Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire.
effect.es: Este ataque hace 30 puntos de daño más por cada Energía en el Coste de Retirada del Pokémon Activo de tu rival.
effect.it: Questo attacco infligge 30 danni in più per ogni Energia nel costo di ritirata del Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario.
effect.de: Diese Attacke fügt für jede Energie in den Rückzugskosten des Aktiven Pokémon deines Gegners 30 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.
effect.pt-br: Este ataque causa 30 pontos de dano a mais para cada Energia no Custo de Recuo do Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente.
effect.zh-tw: 增加對手的戰鬥寶可夢撤退所需的能量的數量×30點傷害。
effect.ja: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.
effect.ko: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

description.en:
If the leaves on its head are pruned with
regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into
a fine plump shape.
description.fr: Si on taille ses feuilles de temps à autre, cela lui donne une forme parfaitement ronde et harmonieuse.
description.es: Adquiere un aspecto esplendoroso cuando se le recortan las hojas de la cabeza con cierta asiduidad.
description.it: Le foglie che ha sul capo vanno spuntate di tanto in tanto per permettergli di crescere florido e bello rotondo.
description.de: Wenn man ab und zu seine Blätter schneidet, wächst sein Körper rund und prächtig heran.
description.pt-br: Se as folhas em sua cabeça forem podadas regularmente, este Pokémon pode crescer com um elegante formato rechonchudo.
description.zh-tw: 如果偶爾修剪葉子，就會長成圓鼓鼓很華麗的樣子。
description.ja:
If the leaves on its head are pruned with
regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into
a fine plump shape.
description.ko:
If the leaves on its head are pruned with
regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into
a fine plump shape.

description.en:
No matter how much time and money is spent
raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when
they bloom in the wild.
description.fr: La main la plus verte au monde ne saurait faire éclore une fleur de Fragilady aussi belle que celles qui s'épanouissent à l'état sauvage.
description.es: Por muchos esfuerzos o dinero que destine la gente para hacerla florecer, siempre es más bella la flor que brota en un ejemplar salvaje.
description.it: Per quanto si possano impiegare tempo, denaro e fatica nella cura di questo Pokémon, il suo fiore sarà sempre più bello se sboccia in natura.
description.de: Egal, wie viel Mühe und Geld investiert wird, sein Blumenschmuck ist wild gewachsen immer schöner als von Menschenhand gezüchtet.
description.pt-br: Não importa quanto tempo e dinheiro é gasto no seu crescimento, suas flores serão sempre mais bonitas quando florescem na selva.
description.zh-tw: 無論花多少功夫和金錢，比起借助人工手段培育出的花，在野外綻放的花更美。
description.ja:
No matter how much time and money is spent
raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when
they bloom in the wild.
description.ko:
No matter how much time and money is spent
raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when
they bloom in the wild.

effect.en: Each of your {G} Pokémon gets +20 HP.
effect.fr: Chacun de vos Pokémon {G} reçoit + 20 PV.
effect.es: Cada uno de tus Pokémon {G} obtiene 20 PS más.
effect.it: Ognuno dei tuoi Pokémon {G} ha +20 PS.
effect.de: Jedes deiner {G}-Pokémon erhält +20 KP.
effect.pt-br: Cada um dos seus Pokémon {G} recebe +20 PS.
effect.zh-tw: 只要這隻寶可夢在場上,自己的所有{G}寶可夢的最大HP+20。
effect.ja: Each of your {G} Pokémon gets +20 HP.
effect.ko: Each of your {G} Pokémon gets +20 HP.

description.en: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.
description.fr: Sa grande mâchoire réduit même les rochers en miettes. Il se bat avec sa colonie pour protéger ses Œufs des attaques des Dunaconda.
description.es: Con sus grandes mandíbulas puede destrozar incluso rocas. Lucha en grupo para proteger sus larvas del ataque de los Sandaconda.
description.it: Le grandi mandibole possono frantumare anche la roccia. Lotta con la colonia per proteggere le sue Uova da Sandaconda.
description.de: Ihre mächtigen Kiefer können Felsen zerbeißen. Sie rotten sich zu Gruppen zusammen, um ihre Eier vor Sanaconda zu beschützen.
description.pt-br: Estes Pokémon conseguem mastigar túneis nas rochas com suas mandíbulas enormes. Trabalham em equipe para proteger seus ovos de Sandaconda.
description.zh-tw: 巨大的顎部能咬碎岩石。為了不讓沙螺蟒把蛋搶走，會和其他同類一起並肩戰鬥。
description.ja: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.
description.ko: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

effect.en: If Durant is on your Bench, this attack does 30 more damage.
effect.fr: Si Fermite est sur votre Banc, cette attaque inflige 30 dégâts supplémentaires.
effect.es: Si Durant está en tu Banca, este ataque hace 30 puntos de daño más.
effect.it: Se Durant è nella tua panchina, questo attacco infligge 30 danni in più.
effect.de: Wenn sich Fermicula auf deiner Bank befindet, fügt diese Attacke 30 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.
effect.pt-br: Se Durant estiver no seu Banco, este ataque causará 30 pontos de dano a mais.
effect.zh-tw: 若自己的備戰區有「鐵蟻」,則增加30點傷害。
effect.ja: If Durant is on your Bench, this attack does 30 more damage.
effect.ko: If Durant is on your Bench, this attack does 30 more damage.

description.en: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.
description.fr: Il dégage une odeur sucrée qui fascine les êtres alentour. Celle-ci est plus forte lorsqu'il est exposé au soleil.
description.es: Su cuerpo desprende una dulce fragancia que embriaga a quien tiene a su alrededor. Esta se intensifica al exponerse a los rayos del sol.
description.it: Il dolce profumo che emana dal corpo incanta chiunque si trovi nelle vicinanze e si intensifica quando il Pokémon si espone al sole.
description.de: Es verzaubert alle in seiner Umgebung mit dem süßen Duft, der von ihm ausgeht. Dieser wird durch Sonnenschein noch intensiver.
description.pt-br: O aroma doce que exala de seu corpo encanta todos à sua volta. O cheiro fica mais forte quando esse Pokémon está no sol.
description.zh-tw: 會用身體發出甜甜香氣，讓周圍的一切為之傾倒。照到陽光後香氣會變得更濃郁。
description.ja: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.
description.ko: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

description.en: The hardness of Floragato's fur depends on the Pokémon's mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.
description.fr: La rigidité de ses poils dépend de son état d'esprit. Quand il se prépare au combat, ceux-ci se hérissent et sont acérés comme des aiguilles.
description.es: La dureza de su pelaje cambia según su estado de ánimo. Cuando se prepara para combatir, se vuelve duro y punzante como agujas.
description.it: La durezza della pelliccia cambia in base al suo stato d'animo. Quando si accinge alla lotta, il suo pelo diventa irto di punte acuminate come aghi.
description.de: Die Geschmeidigkeit seines Fells ändert sich je nach Laune des Pokémon. Macht es sich für den Kampf bereit, wird das Fell so spitz wie Nadeln.
description.pt-br: A rigidez do pelo de Floragato depende do humor do Pokémon. Quando Floragato está pronto para a batalha, seu pelo fica arrepiado e pontiagudo.
description.zh-tw: 體毛的硬度會隨心情而變。進入迎戰狀態時，體毛會變得如針般尖銳。
description.ja: The hardness of Floragato's fur depends on the Pokémon's mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.
description.ko: The hardness of Floragato's fur depends on the Pokémon's mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

effect.en: Choose a spot from among your opponent's Active Spot and Bench. At the end of your opponent's next turn, do 70 damage to the Pokémon in the spot you chose.
effect.fr: Choisissez un emplacement parmi ceux situés sur le Banc de votre adversaire et sur son Poste Actif. À la fin du prochain tour de votre adversaire, infligez 70 dégâts au Pokémon situé sur l'emplacement choisi.
effect.es: Elige 1 puesto de entre el Puesto Activo y la Banca de tu rival. Al final del próximo turno de tu rival, haz 70 puntos de daño al Pokémon del puesto elegido.
effect.it: Scegli una posizione tra quella attiva e quelle nella panchina del tuo avversario. Alla fine del prossimo turno del tuo avversario, infliggi 70 danni al Pokémon che si trova in quella posizione.
effect.de: Wähle 1 Position auf der Bank oder die Aktive Position deines Gegners aus. Füge dem Pokémon auf der Position, die du gewählt hast, am Ende des nächsten Zuges deines Gegners 70 Schadenspunkte zu.
effect.pt-br: Escolha 1 lugar dentre o Campo Ativo e o Banco do seu oponente. No final do próximo turno do seu oponente, cause 70 pontos de dano ao Pokémon no lugar que você escolheu.
effect.zh-tw: 選擇對手的戰鬥場或1個備戰區位置。在下個對手的回合結束時,位於所選位置的寶可夢受到70點傷害。
effect.ja: Choose a spot from among your opponent's Active Spot and Bench. At the end of your opponent's next turn, do 70 damage to the Pokémon in the spot you chose.
effect.ko: Choose a spot from among your opponent's Active Spot and Bench. At the end of your opponent's next turn, do 70 damage to the Pokémon in the spot you chose.

description.en: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.
description.fr: Le fruit qui surmonte sa tête sécrète une huile qui le protège de ses adversaires. Ce liquide a un goût si désagréable qu'il fait grimacer.
description.es: Se defiende de sus rivales segregando por el fruto de su cabeza un aceite tan amargo y agrio que cualquiera daría un respingo al probarlo.
description.it: Si protegge dai nemici secernendo un olio dal gusto incredibilmente amaro e allappante dal frutto che ha sulla testa.
description.de: Um sich vor Feinden zu schützen, sondert es aus der Frucht auf seinem Kopf Öl ab. Dieses ist so bitter, dass es einen zusammenzucken lässt.
description.pt-br: Protege-se dos inimigos liberando azeite da fruta em sua cabeça. O azeite é amargo e tão forte que é capaz de fazer alguém desistir de atacar.
description.zh-tw: 會從頭上的果實噴出油來保護自己不受敵人攻擊。油的味道苦澀到會讓人跳起來。
description.ja: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.
description.ko: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

effect.en: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
effect.fr: Soignez 10 dégâts de ce Pokémon.
effect.es: Cura 10 puntos de daño a este Pokémon.
effect.it: Cura questo Pokémon da 10 danni.
effect.de: Heile 10 Schadenspunkte bei diesem Pokémon.
effect.pt-br: Cure 10 pontos de dano deste Pokémon.
effect.zh-tw: 將這隻寶可夢恢復10HP。
effect.pt: Cure 10 pontos de dano deste Pokémon.
effect.ja: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
effect.ko: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

description.en: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.
description.fr: Ce Pokémon partage volontiers son huile fraîche et délicieuse. Il vit en harmonie avec les êtres humains depuis les temps anciens.
description.es: No duda en compartir su delicioso aceite de fresco aroma. Convive con los seres humanos desde hace mucho tiempo.
description.it: Condivide con gli altri il suo delizioso olio dal fresco profumo. Convive con gli esseri umani fin da tempi antichi.
description.de: Bereitwillig teilt dieses Pokémon sein köstliches, frisch duftendes Öl mit anderen. Seit langer Zeit schon lebt es Seite an Seite mit den Menschen.
description.pt-br: Dolliv compartilha o seu delicioso azeite fresco e aromático com os outros. Esta espécie coexiste com humanos há muito tempo.
description.zh-tw: 會分享自己香氣新鮮、美味可口的油。自古以來就與人類共存，直到現在。
description.ja: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.
description.ko: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

description.en: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.
description.fr: Calme et bienveillant, il partage son huile délicieuse et riche en nutriments avec les Pokémon affaiblis.
description.es: Es pacífico y compasivo. Comparte su delicioso y nutritivo aceite con los Pokémon que han perdido las fuerzas.
description.it: Ha un'indole tranquilla ed estremamente compassionevole. Dona il suo olio delizioso e nutriente ai Pokémon debilitati.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon ist sehr friedlich und gütig. Es teilt sein leckeres, nährstoffreiches Öl mit geschwächten Pokémon.
description.pt-br: Este Pokémon calmo tem muita compaixão. Divide seu delicioso azeite rico em nutrientes com Pokémon enfraquecidos.
description.zh-tw: 性情溫和，慈悲為懷。會把營養豐富且美味可口的油分給虛弱的寶可夢。
description.ja: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.
description.ko: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

effect.en: Once during your turn, you may heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon ex that has any Energy attached. If you do, discard a random Energy from that Pokémon.
effect.fr: Une fois pendant votre tour, vous pouvez soigner 60 dégâts à un de vos Pokémon‐ex auquel de l'Énergie est attachée. Dans ce cas, défaussez une Énergie au hasard de ce Pokémon.
effect.es: Una vez durante tu turno, puedes curar 60 puntos de daño a 1 de tus Pokémon ex que tenga alguna Energía unida. Si lo haces, descarta 1 Energía aleatoria de ese Pokémon.
effect.it: Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, puoi curare da 60 danni uno dei tuoi Pokémon-ex che ha delle Energie assegnate. Se lo fai, rimuovi un'Energia a caso da quel Pokémon.
effect.de: Einmal während deines Zuges kannst du 60 Schadenspunkte bei 1 deiner Pokémon-ex heilen, an das mindestens 1 Energie angelegt ist. Wenn du das machst, lege 1 zufällige Energie von jenem Pokémon ab.
effect.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, você poderá curar 60 pontos de dano de 1 dos seus Pokémon ex que tiver alguma Energia ligada a ele. Se fizer isso, descarte 1 Energia aleatória daquele Pokémon.
effect.zh-tw: 在自己的回合時,可使用1次。將自己的1隻身上附有能量的「寶可夢ex」恢復60HP。然後,將該寶可夢身上的隨機1個能量丟棄。
effect.ja: Once during your turn, you may heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon ex that has any Energy attached. If you do, discard a random Energy from that Pokémon.
effect.ko: Once during your turn, you may heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon ex that has any Energy attached. If you do, discard a random Energy from that Pokémon.

name.ja: オーガポンみどりのめん

description.en: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.
description.fr: Ce Pokémon est curieux et facétieux. Lorsqu'il se bat, il puise dans l'énergie de son masque. Cette énergie est du même type que ce dernier.
description.es: Es bromista y extremadamente curioso. A la hora de combatir, se sirve del tipo de energía que contenga la máscara que lleve puesta.
description.it: È dispettoso e ha una spiccata curiosità. Il tipo dell'energia che sfrutta per lottare dipende da quella contenuta nella maschera.
description.de: Es liebt Streiche und steckt voller Neugier. Zum Kämpfen nutzt es die typenspezifische Energie der Maske, die es trägt.
description.pt-br: Este Pokémon adora pregar peças e é muito curioso. Batalha sugando o tipo de energia contido em suas máscaras.
description.zh-tw: 喜歡惡作劇，好奇心旺盛。能激發出面具蘊藏的屬性的能量來戰鬥。
description.ja: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.
description.ko: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

effect.en: This attack does damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon equal to this Pokémon's remaining HP.
effect.fr: Cette attaque inflige au Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire des dégâts équivalents aux PV restants de ce Pokémon.
effect.es: Este ataque hace una cantidad de daño al Pokémon Activo de tu rival igual a los PS que le queden a este Pokémon.
effect.pt-br: Este ataque causa dano ao Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente equivalente ao PS restante deste Pokémon.
effect.zh-tw: 對對手的戰鬥寶可夢造成與這隻寶可夢的剩餘HP相同數值的傷害。
effect.it: Questo attacco infligge al Pokémon attivo dell'avversario danni pari alla quantità di PS rimasti a questo Pokémon.
effect.de: Diese Attacke fügt dem Aktiven Pokémon deines Gegners Schaden in Höhe der verbleibenden KP dieses Pokémon zu.
effect.ja: This attack does damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon equal to this Pokémon's remaining HP.
effect.ko: This attack does damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon equal to this Pokémon's remaining HP.

name.ja: オーガポンみどりのめんex

effect.en: Each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.
effect.fr: Chacun de vos Pokémon auquel de l'Énergie est attachée guérit de tous les États Spéciaux et ne peut être affecté par aucun État Spécial.
effect.es: Cada uno de tus Pokémon que tenga alguna Energía unida a él se recupera de todas las Condiciones Especiales y no puede verse afectado por ninguna Condición Especial.
effect.it: Ciascuno dei tuoi Pokémon che ha delle Energie assegnate guarisce da tutte le condizioni speciali e non può essere influenzato da condizioni speciali.
effect.de: Jedes deiner Pokémon, an das mindestens 1 Energie angelegt ist, erholt sich von allen Speziellen Zuständen und kann von keinen Speziellen Zuständen betroffen werden.
effect.pt-br: Cada um dos seus Pokémon que tiver alguma Energia ligada a ele se recupera de todas as Condições Especiais e não pode ser afetado por quaisquer Condições Especiais.
effect.zh-tw: 只要這隻寶可夢在場上,自己的所有身上附有能量的寶可夢不會陷入特殊狀態,並將受到的特殊狀態全部恢復。
effect.ja: Each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.
effect.ko: Each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.

effect.en: If the amount of Energy attached to both Active Pokémon is 5 or more, this attack does 60 more damage.
effect.fr: Si la somme des Énergies attachées aux deux Pokémon Actifs est égale à 5 ou plus, cette attaque inflige 60 dégâts supplémentaires.
effect.es: Si la cantidad de Energía unida a ambos Pokémon Activos es de 5 o más, este ataque hace 60 puntos de daño más.
effect.it: Se il totale di Energie assegnate a entrambi i Pokémon attivi è 5 o più, questo attacco infligge 60 danni in più.
effect.de: Wenn die Anzahl der Energien, die an beide Aktiven Pokémon angelegt sind, 5 oder mehr ist, fügt diese Attacke 60 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.
effect.pt-br: Se a quantidade de Energia ligada a ambos os Pokémon Ativos for 5 ou mais, este ataque causará 60 pontos de dano a mais.
effect.zh-tw: 若雙方的戰鬥寶可夢身上的能量為5個以上,則增加60點傷害。
effect.ja: If the amount of Energy attached to both Active Pokémon is 5 or more, this attack does 60 more damage.
effect.ko: If the amount of Energy attached to both Active Pokémon is 5 or more, this attack does 60 more damage.

description.en: If Charmander is healthy, the flame on the tip of its tail will burn vigorously and won’t go out even if it gets a bit wet.
description.fr: Quand il est en bonne santé, la flamme au bout de sa queue continue de flamboyer même si elle est légèrement aspergée d'eau.
description.es: Si está sano, la llama de la punta de su cola arderá vigorosamente, aunque se le moje un poco.
description.it: Se è in forma, la fiamma che ha sulla punta della coda brucia con forza e non si spegne neanche se la coda si bagna un po'.
description.de: Ist es gesund, strahlt die Flamme an seiner Schwanzspitze leuchtend hell und erlischt selbst dann nicht, wenn sie ein wenig nass wird.
description.pt-br: Se Charmander estiver saudável, a chama na ponta da sua cauda queimará vigorosamente e não apagará mesmo que fique um pouco molhada.
description.zh-tw: 如果小火龍的活力十足，那麼尾巴前端的火焰即使稍微淋濕也會熊熊燃燒，不會熄滅。
description.ja: If Charmander is healthy, the flame on the tip of its tail will burn vigorously and won’t go out even if it gets a bit wet.
description.ko: If Charmander is healthy, the flame on the tip of its tail will burn vigorously and won’t go out even if it gets a bit wet.

description.en: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents to battle against. Its aggression will not be quelled if it doesn’t win.
description.fr: Ce Pokémon au sang chaud est constamment à la recherche d'adversaires. Il ne se calme qu'une fois qu'il a gagné.
description.es: Por naturaleza, se acalora con facilidad: siempre está buscando adversarios. Solo se calma cuando gana.
description.it: Turbolento di natura, è sempre alla ricerca di avversari. Si placa solo dopo aver vinto.
description.de: Glutexo hat ein hitziges Gemüt und sucht ständig nach Gegnern. Es beruhigt sich nur, wenn es gewinnt.
description.pt-br: Tem um temperamento explosivo, por isso sempre busca oponentes para enfrentar. Não sossega enquanto não vence.
description.zh-tw: 性情如烈火，無時無刻都在尋找要交戰的對手。得要打贏才會冷靜下來。
description.ja: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents to battle against. Its aggression will not be quelled if it doesn’t win.
description.ko: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents to battle against. Its aggression will not be quelled if it doesn’t win.

effect.en: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may take a {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to your Active {R} Pokémon.
effect.fr: Une fois pendant votre tour, lorsque vous jouez ce Pokémon de votre main pour faire évoluer un de vos Pokémon, vous pouvez prendre une Énergie {R} de votre zone Énergie et l'attacher à votre Pokémon {R} Actif.
effect.es: Una vez durante tu turno, cuando juegas este Pokémon de tu mano para hacer evolucionar a uno de tus Pokémon, puedes unir 1 Energía {R} de tu área de Energía a tu Pokémon {R} Activo.
effect.it: Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, quando giochi questo Pokémon dalla tua mano per far evolvere uno dei tuoi Pokémon, puoi prendere un'Energia {R} dalla Zona Energia e assegnarla al tuo Pokémon {R} attivo.
effect.de: Einmal während deines Zuges, wenn du dieses Pokémon von deiner Hand spielst, um 1 deiner Pokémon zu entwickeln, kannst du 1 {R}-Energie aus deinem Energiebereich an dein Aktives {R}-Pokémon anlegen.
effect.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, quando você jogar este Pokémon da sua mão para evoluir 1 dos seus Pokémon, você poderá pegar 1 Energia {R} da sua Zona de Energia e ligá-la ao seu Pokémon {R} Ativo.
effect.zh-tw: 在自己的回合,當從手牌使出這張卡並完成進化時,可使用1次。從自己的能量區抽出1個{R}能量,附於戰鬥場的{R}寶可夢身上。
effect.ja: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may take a {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to your Active {R} Pokémon.
effect.ko: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may take a {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to your Active {R} Pokémon.

effect.en: If this Pokémon's remaining HP is 110 or less, this attack does 80 more damage.
effect.fr: S'il reste 110 PV ou moins à ce Pokémon, cette attaque inflige 80 dégâts supplémentaires.
effect.es: Si a este Pokémon le quedan 110 PS o menos, este ataque hace 80 puntos de daño más.

description.en: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

description.it: Una volta conquistata la fiducia di Ponyta, è possibile toccare la sua criniera infuocata senza scottarsi.

description.pt-br: Se você foi aceito por Ponyta, a crina abrasadora deste Pokémon misteriosamente não queimará ao ser tocada.
description.zh-tw: 得到了小火馬認可的人，在觸摸牠燃燒著的鬃毛時不會覺得燙手，真是不可思議。

A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug.

description.es: Sus cuerdas vocales y la válvula de su saca de fuego están estrechamente relacionadas. Emite sonidos guturales al expeler llamas.
description.it: Le sue corde vocali sono strettamente collegate alla valvola della sacca ignea. Mentre sputa fiammate tutt'intorno, emette versi rauchi.

description.ko: The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

description.en: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.fr: Il est capable de carboniser ses adversaires avec des flammes à 3 000 °C. Sa voix douce possède des vertus apaisantes pour l'âme.
description.es: Su dulce canto calma el espíritu de quien lo oye. Achicharra a sus enemigos con llamas que llegan a alcanzar los 3000°C.
description.it: Il suo dolce canto placa l'animo di chiunque lo ascolti. Riduce in cenere il nemico con fiamme che raggiungono i 3.000 °C.
description.de: Sein sanfter Gesang beruhigt die Seelen all derer, die ihm lauschen. Feinde verbrennt es mit 3000 °C heißen Flammen zu Asche.
description.pt-br: O canto delicado de Skeledirge acalma o âmago de todos que o ouvem. Torra os inimigos com chamas de mais de 3.000 °C.
description.zh-tw: 溫柔的歌聲能療癒聽者的靈魂。會使用3000度的火焰將敵人燒成灰燼。
description.ja: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.ko: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

effect.en: Once during your turn, you may discard 1 {R} Energy from this Pokémon in order to use this Ability. During this turn, attacks used by your {R} Pokémon do +50 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
effect.fr: Une fois pendant votre tour, vous pouvez défausser une Énergie {R} de ce Pokémon pour pouvoir utiliser ce talent. Pendant ce tour, les attaques de vos Pokémon {R} infligent + 50 dégâts au Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire.
effect.es: Una vez durante tu turno, puedes descartar 1 Energía {R} de este Pokémon para usar esta habilidad. Durante este turno, los ataques de tus Pokémon {R} hacen +50 puntos de daño al Pokémon Activo de tu rival.
effect.it: Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, puoi rimuovere un'Energia {R} da questo Pokémon per usare questa abilità. Durante questo turno, gli attacchi usati dai tuoi Pokémon {R} infliggono +50 danni al Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario.
effect.de: Einmal während deines Zuges kannst du 1 {R}-Energie von diesem Pokémon ablegen, um diese Fähigkeit einzusetzen. Während dieses Zuges fügen Attacken deiner {R}-Pokémon dem Aktiven Pokémon deines Gegners +50 Schadenspunkte zu.
effect.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, você poderá descartar 1 Energia {R} deste Pokémon para usar esta Habilidade. Durante este turno, os ataques usados pelos seus Pokémon {R} causam +50 pontos de dano ao Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente.
effect.zh-tw: 在自己的回合,若將這隻寶可夢身上的1個{R}能量丟棄,則可使用1次。在這個回合,自己的{R}寶可夢使用的招式,對對手的戰鬥寶可夢造成的傷害+50點。
effect.ja: Once during your turn, you may discard 1 {R} Energy from this Pokémon in order to use this Ability. During this turn, attacks used by your {R} Pokémon do +50 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
effect.ko: Once during your turn, you may discard 1 {R} Energy from this Pokémon in order to use this Ability. During this turn, attacks used by your {R} Pokémon do +50 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

description.en: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.
description.fr: Ses puissantes flammes atteignent les 1 000 °C lorsqu'il se bat. Il aime les Baies riches en matières grasses.
description.es: Sus potentes llamas alcanzan los 1000°C cuando combate. Siente predilección por las bayas con un alto contenido graso.
description.it: La sua energia termica aumenta di intensità durante le lotte, raggiungendo i 1.000 °C. Adora le bacche ricche di grassi.
description.de: Im Kampf erreichen seine Flammen Temperaturen von bis zu 1000 °C. Es hat eine Vorliebe für Beeren mit hohem Fettgehalt.
description.pt-br: Seu poder de fogo aumenta quando batalha, atingindo mais de 1.000 °C. Gosta de frutas ricas em gordura.
description.zh-tw: 在進入戰鬥狀態後，火力會上升至攝氏1000度。喜歡吃油脂含量高的樹果。
description.ja: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.
description.ko: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

description.en:
In this form, it draws on the power of fire.
It spears its enemies with thorn-covered ivy.
description.fr: Sous cette forme, il puise dans le pouvoir du feu. Il se sert de sa branche épineuse comme d'une lance pour transpercer ses adversaires.
description.es: Esta forma emplea el poder del fuego. Atraviesa a sus enemigos con una rama llena de espinas que usa a modo de lanza.
description.it: Questa forma sfrutta la forza del fuoco. Trafigge il nemico manovrando la sua liana spinosa come una lancia.
description.de: In dieser Form macht es sich die Kraft des Feuers zunutze. Es verwendet seine dornige Ranke wie einen Speer, um Feinde zu durchbohren.
description.pt-br: Nesta forma, a fonte do seu poder é o fogo. Perfura os inimigos com suas vinhas espinhosas.
description.zh-tw: 激發出火之力量的樣子。會自在操控帶刺的藤蔓，使其像長矛般地刺穿敵手。
description.ja:
In this form, it draws on the power of fire.
It spears its enemies with thorn-covered ivy.
description.ko:
In this form, it draws on the power of fire.
It spears its enemies with thorn-covered ivy.

effect.en: Flip a coin. If heads, take 2 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
effect.fr: Lancez une pièce. Si c'est face, prenez 2 Énergies {R} de votre zone Énergie et attachez‐les à un de vos Pokémon de Banc.
effect.es: Lanza 1 moneda. Si sale cara, une 2 Energías {R} de tu área de Energía a 1 de tus Pokémon en Banca.
effect.it: Lancia una moneta. Se esce testa, prendi 2 Energie {R} dalla tua Zona Energia e assegnale a uno dei tuoi Pokémon in panchina.
effect.de: Wirf 1 Münze. Lege bei Kopf 2 {R}-Energien aus deinem Energiebereich an 1 Pokémon auf deiner Bank an.
effect.pt-br: Jogue uma moeda. Se sair cara, pegue 2 Energias {R} da sua Zona de Energia e ligue-as a 1 dos seus Pokémon no Banco.
effect.zh-tw: 擲1次硬幣若為正面,則從自己的能量區抽出2個{R}能量,附於1隻備戰寶可夢身上。
effect.ja: Flip a coin. If heads, take 2 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
effect.ko: Flip a coin. If heads, take 2 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

description.en:
When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside
its shell and sprays water from its mouth.
description.fr: S'il se sent menacé, il rétracte ses pattes dans sa carapace pour se protéger et crache de l'eau.
description.es: Cuando se siente en peligro, se esconde en su caparazón y escupe chorros de agua por la boca.
description.it: Se si sente minacciato, ritira le zampe nel guscio e inizia a spruzzare acqua dalla bocca.
description.de: Fühlt es sich bedroht, verkriecht es sich in seinen Panzer und spuckt Wasser aus seinem Maul.
description.pt-br: Quando este Pokémon sente-se ameaçado, esconde-se dentro do seu casco e lança água pela boca.
description.zh-tw: 當牠遇到危險的時候，會將四肢收回甲殼裡保護自己，同時從嘴裡噴出水來。
description.ja:
When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside
its shell and sprays water from its mouth.
description.ko:
When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside
its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

description.en:
It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to
maintain its balance while swimming.
description.fr: Il se sert habilement de sa queue et de ses oreilles touffues pour garder son équilibre sous l'eau.
description.es: Utiliza hábilmente sus peludas orejas y la cola para mantener el equilibrio al nadar.
description.it: Controlla abilmente le orecchie e la coda coperte di pelo, mantenendo l'assetto mentre nuota.
description.de: Es balanciert geschickt mit seinen buschigen Ohren und dem Schweif, während es im Wasser schwimmt.
description.pt-br: Controla suas orelhas e cauda felpudas com maestria para manter o equilíbrio enquanto nada.
description.zh-tw: 會靈巧地擺動自己毛茸茸的耳朵和尾巴，藉此在水中保持平衡。
description.ja:
It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to
maintain its balance while swimming.
description.ko:
It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to
maintain its balance while swimming.

effect.en: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.
effect.fr: Tant que ce Pokémon est sur votre Banc, évitez tous les dégâts infligés à ce Pokémon par les attaques.
effect.es: Mientras este Pokémon esté en tu Banca, evita todo el daño infligido a este Pokémon por ataques.
effect.it: Fintanto che questo Pokémon è nella tua panchina, previeni tutti i danni inflitti a questo Pokémon da qualsiasi attacco.
effect.de: Solange sich dieses Pokémon auf deiner Bank befindet, verhindere allen Schaden, der diesem Pokémon durch Attacken zugefügt wird.
effect.pt-br: Enquanto este Pokémon estiver no seu Banco, previna todo o dano causado a este Pokémon por ataques.
effect.zh-tw: 只要這隻寶可夢在備戰區,不會受到招式的傷害。
effect.ja: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.
effect.ko: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

effect.en: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {W} Energy attached, this attack also does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
effect.fr: Si ce Pokémon a au moins 3 Énergies {W} de plus, cette attaque inflige également 50 dégâts à deux des Pokémon de Banc de votre adversaire.
effect.es: Si este Pokémon tiene por lo menos 3 Energías {W} adicionales unidas a él, este ataque también hace 50 puntos de daño a 2 de los Pokémon en Banca de tu rival.
effect.it: Se questo Pokémon ha almeno 3 Energie {W} extra assegnate, questo attacco infligge anche 50 danni a due dei Pokémon nella panchina del tuo avversario.
effect.de: Wenn an dieses Pokémon mindestens 3 extra {W}-Energien angelegt sind, fügt diese Attacke auch 2 Pokémon auf der Bank deines Gegners 50 Schadenspunkte zu.
effect.pt-br: Se este Pokémon tiver pelo menos 3 Energias {W} extras ligadas a ele, este ataque também causará 50 pontos de dano a 2 dos Pokémon no Banco do seu oponente.
effect.zh-tw: 若額外附有3個{W}能量,則對手的2隻備戰寶可夢也各受到50點傷害。
effect.ja: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {W} Energy attached, this attack also does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
effect.ko: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {W} Energy attached, this attack also does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

description.en:
In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards
with its six tails and sprays them around to cool
itself off.
description.fr: Quand il fait chaud, il crée des fragments de glace avec ses six queues et les disperse autour de lui pour se rafraîchir.
description.es: Cuando hace calor, crea rocas de hielo con sus seis colas y las disemina por los alrededores para enfriar su cuerpo.
description.it: Quando fa caldo, abbassa la temperatura corporea sparpagliando tutto attorno a sé pezzi di ghiaccio che crea dalle sue sei code.
description.de: Bei heißem Wetter erzeugt es mit seinen sechs Schweifen Kiesel aus Eis. Diese verteilt es in der Nähe, um seinen Körper abzukühlen.
description.pt-br: Quando o clima está quente, este Pokémon cria cacos de gelo com suas seis caudas e os espalha para se refrescar.
description.zh-tw: 天氣熱的時候會用6根尾巴製造冰礫再散向周圍，藉此讓身體冷卻下來。
description.ja:
In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards
with its six tails and sprays them around to cool
itself off.
description.ko:
In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards

itself off.

effect.en: During your opponent's next turn, they can't take any Energy from their Energy Zone to attach to their Active Pokémon.
effect.fr: Pendant le prochain tour de votre adversaire, il ne peut prendre aucune Énergie de sa zone Énergie pour en attacher à son Pokémon Actif.
effect.es: Durante el próximo turno de tu rival, este no puede unir ninguna Energía de su área de Energía a su Pokémon Activo.
effect.it: Durante il suo prossimo turno, il tuo avversario non può prendere nessuna Energia dalla sua Zona Energia per assegnarla al suo Pokémon attivo.
effect.de: Dein Gegner kann während seines nächsten Zuges keine Energie aus seinem Energiebereich an sein Aktives Pokémon anlegen.
effect.pt-br: Durante o próximo turno do seu oponente, ele não poderá pegar nenhuma Energia da Zona de Energia para ligar ao Pokémon Ativo dele.
effect.zh-tw: 在下個對手的回合,對手無法從能量區抽出能量,附於戰鬥寶可夢身上。
effect.ja: During your opponent's next turn, they can't take any Energy from their Energy Zone to attach to their Active Pokémon.
effect.ko: During your opponent's next turn, they can't take any Energy from their Energy Zone to attach to their Active Pokémon.

description.en: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.
description.fr: Ramoloss semble toujours distrait, mais personne ne sait vraiment à quoi il pense. Il adore pêcher à l'aide de sa queue.
description.es: Está siempre en su mundo, pero nadie sabe en qué piensa. Suele pescar con la cola.
description.it: È sempre assorto, ma nessuno sa a cosa stia pensando. Si serve della coda per pescare.
description.de: Flegmon ist stets in Gedanken versunken, aber niemand weiß, worüber es nachdenkt. Seine Rute nutzt es geschickt zum Angeln.
description.pt-br: Está sempre distraidamente perdido em pensamentos, mas ninguém sabe o que ele está pensando. Tem muita habilidade em pescar com a cauda.
description.zh-tw: 總是一副在發呆的樣子，不知道在想些什麼。擅長用尾巴來釣食物。
description.ja: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.
description.ko: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

effect.es: Lanza 3 monedas. Este ataque también hace 20 puntos de daño por cada cara a cada uno de los Pokémon en Banca de tu rival.
effect.it: Lancia 3 volte una moneta. Questo attacco infligge anche 20 danni ogni volta che esce testa a ciascuno dei Pokémon nella panchina del tuo avversario.
effect.de: Wirf 3 Münzen. Diese Attacke fügt auch jedem Pokémon auf der Bank deines Gegners 20 Schadenspunkte pro Kopf zu.

effect.zh-tw: 擲3次硬幣,對手的所有備戰寶可夢也受到正面出現的次數×20點傷害。

effect.ko: Flip 3 coins. This attack also does 20 damage for each heads to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

description.en:
In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than
the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
description.fr: Il paraît que ses lointains ancêtres étaient assez puissants, mais les spécimens d'aujourd'hui sont extrêmement faibles.
description.es: En un pasado lejano, era más fuerte de lo que hoy son sus débiles descendientes.
description.it: Pare che anticamente fosse un tantino più forte. Oggi è così debole da fare quasi pena.
description.de: Die urzeitlichen Vorfahren dieses Pokémon waren etwas stärker als ihre heutigen, kümmerlichen Nachkommen.
description.pt-br: No passado distante, era um pouco mais forte que os descendentes terrivelmente fracos que existem hoje.
description.zh-tw: 很久以前的鯉魚王好像比現在強上一些，但是現在卻弱得可憐。
description.ja:

description.ko:

effect.es: Pon una carta aleatoria de tu baraja que evolucione de este Pokémon sobre este Pokémon para hacerlo evolucionar.
effect.it: Prendi una carta a caso che si evolve da questo Pokémon dal mazzo e mettigliela sopra per farlo evolvere.
effect.de: Lege eine zufällige Karte aus deinem Deck, die sich aus diesem Pokémon entwickelt, auf dieses Pokémon, um es zu entwickeln.
effect.pt-br: Coloque uma carta aleatória do seu baralho que evolua deste Pokémon sobre este Pokémon para evoluí-lo.

effect.ko: Put a random card from your deck that evolves from this Pokémon onto this Pokémon to evolve it.

effect.fr: Une fois pendant votre tour, si ce Pokémon est sur le Poste Actif, vous pouvez échanger le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire contre un de ses Pokémon de Banc. (Votre adversaire choisit le nouveau Pokémon Actif.)
effect.es: Una vez durante tu turno, si este Pokémon está en el Puesto Activo, puedes mover el Pokémon Activo de tu rival a la Banca. (Tu rival elige el nuevo Pokémon Activo).
effect.it: Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, se questo Pokémon è in posizione attiva, puoi spostare il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario nella sua panchina. Il tuo avversario sceglie il nuovo Pokémon attivo.
effect.de: Einmal während deines Zuges, wenn dieses Pokémon in der Aktiven Position ist, kannst du das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners auf seine Bank auswechseln. (Dein Gegner wählt das neue Aktive Pokémon.)
effect.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, se este Pokémon estiver no Campo Ativo, você poderá mandar o Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente para o Banco. (O seu oponente escolhe o novo Pokémon Ativo.)
effect.zh-tw: 若這隻寶可夢在戰鬥場上,則在自己的回合時可使用1次。將對手的戰鬥寶可夢與備戰寶可夢互換。[[由對手選擇放置於戰鬥場的寶可夢。]]

description.en:
When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed
rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its
small size.
description.fr: Dans l'eau, les battements de sa grande nageoire caudale le font accélérer de manière fulgurante. Malgré sa petite taille, il est très costaud.
description.es: Batir su gran aleta caudal en el agua le permite nadar muy rápido. A pesar de su reducido tamaño, tiene mucha fuerza.
description.it: Può acquisire una straordinaria velocità agitando la grande pinna caudale nell'acqua. È minuto, ma forte.
description.de: Wenn es seine große Schwanzflosse einsetzt, kann es im Wasser schnell beschleunigen. Es ist überraschend stark für seine geringe Größe.
description.pt-br: Ao utilizar sua grande barbatana, ganha velocidade rapidamente na água. É forte, apesar de seu pequeno porte.
description.zh-tw: 如果用大大的尾鰭划水，速度就會快速提升。身體雖小卻很有力氣。
description.ja:
When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed
rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its
small size.
description.ko:
When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed
rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its
small size.

description.en:
It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers
poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents
that are bogged down and unable to move.
description.fr: En terrain boueux, il peut exprimer son plein potentiel et dominer rapidement les adversaires embourbés qui peinent à se mouvoir.
description.es: Está en su salsa en terrenos lodosos, donde aprovecha la reducida movilidad de sus rivales para someterlos en un abrir y cerrar de ojos.
description.it: Dà il meglio di sé nei terreni fangosi, dove approfitta della mobilità ridotta degli avversari per sopraffarli in un attimo.
description.de: Auf instabilem, schlammigem Untergrund kann es sein wahres Potenzial entfalten. Feststeckende Gegner überwältigt es im Handumdrehen.
description.pt-br: Prefere terrenos lamacentos e escorregadios. Atordoa os oponentes presos na lama, incapazes de se mover.
description.zh-tw: 在泥濘的地上更能發揮真本事。會把無法動彈的對手一口氣逼入絕境。
description.ja:
It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers
poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents
that are bogged down and unable to move.
description.ko:

effect.fr: Défaussez 2 Énergies au hasard parmi celles attachées à tous les Pokémon en jeu (les vôtres et ceux de votre adversaire).
effect.es: Descarta 2 Energías aleatorias de entre las Energías unidas a todos los Pokémon (tanto tuyos como de tu rival).
effect.it: Rimuovi 2 Energie a caso fra quelle assegnate a tutti i Pokémon, sia tuoi che del tuo avversario.
effect.de: Lege 2 zufällige Energien von allen Energien, die an alle Pokémon (deine und die deines Gegners) angelegt sind, ab.
effect.pt-br: Descarte 2 Energias aleatórias dentre as Energias ligadas a todos os Pokémon (seus e do seu oponente).
effect.zh-tw: 從雙方的所有寶可夢身上附加的能量中隨機丟棄2個能量。
effect.ja: Discard 2 random Energy from among the Energy attached to all Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).
effect.ko: Discard 2 random Energy from among the Energy attached to all Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

description.en: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.
description.fr: Il possède une mâchoire puissante garnie de dents acérées. Les marins ne s'approchent jamais des eaux habitées par les Carvanha.
description.es: Los marineros evitan por completo las zonas donde habita este Pokémon de afilados colmillos y fuertes mandíbulas.
description.it: È dotato di denti affilati e mascelle robuste. Chi viaggia per mare si tiene accuratamente alla larga dalle tane di Carvanha.
description.de: Es verfügt über äußerst spitze Zähne und kräftige Kiefer. Seefahrer meiden die Lebensräume von Kanivanha um jeden Preis.
description.pt-br: Esses Pokémon têm presas afiadas e mandíbulas poderosas. Marinheiros evitam covis de Carvanha a todo custo.
description.zh-tw: 擁有銳利的牙齒和結實的下巴。船員們絕對不會去靠近利牙魚棲息的地方。
description.ja: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.
description.ko: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

effect.en: Take a {W} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched {W} Pokémon.
effect.fr: Prenez une Énergie {W} de votre zone Énergie et attachez-la à l'un de vos Pokémon {W} de Banc.
effect.es: Une 1 Energía {W} de tu área de Energía a 1 de tus Pokémon {W} en Banca.
effect.it: Prendi un'Energia {W} dalla tua Zona Energia e assegnala a uno dei tuoi Pokémon {W} in panchina.
effect.de: Lege 1 {W}-Energie aus deinem Energiebereich an 1 {W}-Pokémon auf deiner Bank an.
effect.pt-br: Pegue 1 Energia {W} da sua Zona de Energia e ligue-a a 1 dos seus Pokémon {W} no Banco.
effect.zh-tw: 從自己的能量區抽出1個{W}能量,附於備戰區的{W}寶可夢身上。
effect.ja: Take a {W} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched {W} Pokémon.
effect.ko: Take a {W} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched {W} Pokémon.

description.en: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.
description.fr: Il ressemble à un énorme ballon quand il avale de très grandes quantités d'eau de mer. Il dévore une tonne de nourriture par jour.
description.es: Cuando traga una gran cantidad de agua marina, se hincha hasta parecer una pelota. Necesita una tonelada de alimento al día.
description.it: Se inghiotte molta acqua diventa una specie di palla rimbalzante. Ha bisogno di una tonnellata di cibo al giorno.
description.de: Verschluckt es eine große Menge Meerwasser, wird sein Körper elastisch wie ein Ball. Es frisst täglich eine Tonne Nahrung.
description.zh-tw: 喝入大量的海水之後，身體會鼓成像球一樣。每天要吃掉１噸的食物。
description.pt-br: Quando suga um grande volume de água do mar, transforma-se em uma bola grande e saltitante. Come uma tonelada de comida diariamente.
description.ja: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.
description.ko: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

effect.en: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.
effect.fr: Ce Pokémon guérit de tous les États Spéciaux.
effect.es: Este Pokémon se recupera de todas las Condiciones Especiales.
effect.de: Dieses Pokémon erholt sich von allen Speziellen Zuständen.
effect.pt-br: Este Pokémon se recupera de todas as Condições Especiais.
effect.zh-tw: 將這隻寶可夢的特殊狀態全部恢復。
effect.it: Questo Pokémon guarisce da tutte le condizioni speciali.
effect.ja: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.
effect.ko: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

description.en: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms schools and lives at the bottom of rivers that teem with plant life.
description.fr: Ce Pokémon d'apparence miteuse vit en larges bancs, au fond des rivières qui abondent en plantes aquatiques.
description.es: Es el Pokémon con aspecto más penoso. Habitan y forman bancos en los lechos de los ríos con abundantes plantas acuáticas.
description.it: Il Pokémon dall'aspetto più misero. Vive in grandi gruppi nei letti dei fiumi ricchi di piante acquatiche.
description.de: Das schäbigste Pokémon von allen. Es lebt in großen Gruppen auf dem Grund von Flüssen, wo viele Wasserpflanzen wachsen.
description.pt-br: É o Pokémon mais desgastado de todos. Forma cardumes e vive no leito de rios repletos de plantas.
description.zh-tw: 最寒酸的寶可夢。在有許多水草的河底群聚而居。
description.ja: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms schools and lives at the bottom of rivers that teem with plant life.
description.ko: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms schools and lives at the bottom of rivers that teem with plant life.

effect.ko: Once during your turn, you may take a {W} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

effect.en: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
effect.fr: Le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire est maintenant Endormi.
effect.es: El Pokémon Activo de tu rival pasa a estar Dormido.
effect.it: Il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario viene addormentato.
effect.de: Das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners schläft jetzt.
effect.pt-br: O Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente agora está Adormecido.
effect.zh-tw: 將對手的戰鬥寶可夢睡眠。
effect.ja: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
effect.ko: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

description.en:
It protects its skin by covering its body in
delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air,
it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
description.fr: Il protège son corps en l'entourant d'une mousse délicate. Malgré son apparence insouciante, ce Pokémon est en fait constamment à l'affût.
description.es: Protege su piel cubriendo el cuerpo con una fina capa de burbujas. Aunque parezca despreocupado, no deja de vigilar con astucia lo que le rodea.
description.it: Si protegge avvolgendo il corpo in una schiuma delicata. Nonostante l'aria spensierata, scruta sempre l'ambiente circostante con molta attenzione.
description.de: Es schützt seine Haut mit feinen Blasen, die seinen Körper umhüllen. Es mag unbekümmert aussehen, behält die Umgebung aber immer aufmerksam im Auge.
description.pt-br: Protege sua pele cobrindo seu corpo com bolhas delicadas. Por trás do seu ar alegre e despreocupado, mantém um olhar atento sobre os arredores.
description.zh-tw: 以細膩的泡沫包住身體，保護皮膚。裝出一副悠閒的樣子，但其實精明地打量著四周。
description.ja:
It protects its skin by covering its body in
delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air,
it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
description.ko:
It protects its skin by covering its body in
delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air,
it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

description.en:
Its swiftness is unparalleled.
It can scale a tower of more
than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.
description.fr: Son agilité est incomparable. Il peut gravir une tour de 600 m de haut en moins d'une minute.
description.es: Su agilidad no tiene parangón. De hecho, es capaz de escalar una torre de más de 600 metros en tan solo un minuto.
description.it: Grazie alla sua straordinaria agilità, è in grado di scalare una torre alta più di 600 m in meno di un minuto.
description.de: Seine Flinkheit sucht ihresgleichen. Es kann einen 600 m hohen Turm in weniger als einer Minute erklimmen.
description.pt-br: Sua velocidade é incomparável. Pode escalar uma torre de mais de 600 metros em um minuto.
description.zh-tw: 靈巧的動作不會輸給任何人。只需1分鐘就能登上超過600公尺高的塔頂。
description.ja:
Its swiftness is unparalleled.
It can scale a tower of more
than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.
description.ko:
Its swiftness is unparalleled.
It can scale a tower of more
than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

effect.en: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
effect.fr: Échangez ce Pokémon contre l'un de vos Pokémon de Banc.
effect.es: Cambia este Pokémon por 1 de tus Pokémon en Banca.
effect.it: Scambia questo Pokémon con uno della tua panchina.
effect.de: Tausche dieses Pokémon gegen 1 Pokémon auf deiner Bank aus.
effect.pt-br: Troque este Pokémon por 1 dos seus Pokémon no Banco.
effect.zh-tw: 將這隻寶可夢與備戰寶可夢互換。
effect.ja: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
effect.ko: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

effect.es: Una vez durante tu turno, puedes cambiar tu Pokémon {W} Activo por 1 de tus Pokémon en Banca.

effect.ko: Once during your turn, you may switch your Active {W} Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

description.en: It’s a very cautious Pokémon. When it has no choice but to battle, it hides itself before attacking.
description.fr: Ce Pokémon est très prudent. Quand il ne peut pas échapper au combat, il se camoufle avant d'attaquer.
description.es: Es tan precavido que, cuando no le queda más remedio que combatir, siempre se camufla antes de atacar.
description.it: È molto cauto. Quando è costretto a lottare, sferra i suoi attacchi solo dopo essersi mimetizzato.
description.de: Es ist extrem vorsichtig. Wenn sich ein Kampf nicht vermeiden lässt, greift es erst an, nachdem es sich getarnt hat.
description.pt-br: É um Pokémon muito cauteloso. Quando não tem outra saída a não ser batalhar, esconde-se antes de atacar.
description.zh-tw: 警戒心十分強。遇到無論如何都得戰鬥時，會先讓身影消失再發動攻擊。
description.ja: It’s a very cautious Pokémon. When it has no choice but to battle, it hides itself before attacking.
description.ko: It’s a very cautious Pokémon. When it has no choice but to battle, it hides itself before attacking.

effect.en: Put a random Pokémon from your deck into your hand.
effect.fr: Ajoutez au hasard un Pokémon de votre deck à votre main.
effect.es: Pon Pokémon aleatorio de tu baraja en tu mano.
effect.it: Prendi un Pokémon a caso dal tuo mazzo e aggiungilo alle carte che hai in mano.
effect.de: Nimm 1 zufälliges Pokémon aus deinem Deck auf deine Hand.
effect.pt-br: Coloque Pokémon aleatório do seu baralho na sua mão.
effect.zh-tw: 從自己的牌庫隨機將張寶可夢卡加入手牌。
effect.ja: Put a random Pokémon from your deck into your hand.
effect.ko: Put a random Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

description.en: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it defends its home by laying traps.
description.fr: Paresseux mais intelligent, ce Pokémon pose des pièges pour protéger son territoire.
description.es: Pese a su falta de interés en general, es muy inteligente y protege su hogar colocando trampas.
description.it: Naturalmente svogliato ma di grande intelligenza, protegge la tana piazzando delle trappole.
description.de: Es ist hochintelligent, aber zugleich lustlos und faul. Daher verteidigt es sein Revier, indem es Fallen aufstellt.
description.pt-br: Este Pokémon é muito inteligente e bastante preguiçoso. Defende seu território com armadilhas.
description.zh-tw: 雖然個性上很怕麻煩，但智商非常高，會設置陷阱來保護自己的住處。
description.ja: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it defends its home by laying traps.
description.ko: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it defends its home by laying traps.

effect.en: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may do 20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
effect.fr: Une fois pendant votre tour, lorsque vous jouez ce Pokémon de votre main pour faire évoluer un de vos Pokémon, vous pouvez infliger 20 dégâts au Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire.
effect.es: Una vez durante tu turno, cuando juegas este Pokémon de tu mano para hacer evolucionar a uno de tus Pokémon, puedes hacer 20 puntos de daño al Pokémon Activo de tu rival.
effect.it: Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, quando giochi questo Pokémon dalla tua mano per far evolvere uno dei tuoi Pokémon, puoi infliggere 20 danni al Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario.
effect.de: Einmal während deines Zuges, wenn du dieses Pokémon von deiner Hand spielst, um 1 deiner Pokémon zu entwickeln, kannst du dem Aktiven Pokémon deines Gegners 20 Schadenspunkte zufügen.
effect.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, quando você jogar este Pokémon da sua mão para evoluir 1 dos seus Pokémon, você poderá causar 20 pontos de dano ao Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente.
effect.zh-tw: 在自己的回合,當從手牌使出這張卡並完成進化時,可使用1次。對手的戰鬥寶可夢受到20點傷害。
effect.ja: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may do 20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
effect.ko: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may do 20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

description.en: It may present itself as being well-mannered, but deep down, it still has a lazy side. It will slack off when its Trainer isn’t looking.
description.fr: Il agit de manière distinguée, mais c'est en réalité un partenaire toujours aussi paresseux qui flâne dès qu'on a le dos tourné.
description.es: Muestra un comportamiento educado, pero en el fondo sigue siendo perezoso. En cuanto su Entrenador se gira, se pone a holgazanear.
description.it: Sfoggia modi signorili, ma in realtà è un pigrone che approfitta di ogni distrazione di chi lo allena per battere la fiacca.
description.de: Es präsentiert sich gern gesittet, aber im Herzen ist und bleibt es ein Faulpelz. Lässt sein Trainer es aus den Augen, gönnt es sich eine Auszeit.
description.pt-br: Aparenta ter boas maneiras, mas, no fundo, tem um lado preguiçoso. Vai mandriar quando seu Treinador não estiver de olho.
description.zh-tw: 雖然表現得很有紳士風度，但生性懶惰的部分依舊沒變，因此在訓練家沒看著牠時就會偷懶。
description.ja: It may present itself as being well-mannered, but deep down, it still has a lazy side. It will slack off when its Trainer isn’t looking.
description.ko: It may present itself as being well-mannered, but deep down, it still has a lazy side. It will slack off when its Trainer isn’t looking.
